subject: FP3 Grade Report — Ready to Post
body:
FP3 (finals-diagnostic-3) graded from Kai's handwritten exam. Marcus reviewed and confirmed all answers. Ready to post.

FINAL SCORE: 10/15 questions = 67% per-question | 23/29 inputs = 79% per-input

FULL GRADE TABLE:

Q2  | W1.b | MC | Answer: 1/9            | Correct: B=1/9           | PASS
Q3  | W2.b | FR | abs value, (-2,-6)     | Correct: same            | PASS  3/3 inputs
Q4  | W2.c | FR | sqrt(x), dom=3, rng=5  | Correct: same            | PASS  3/3 inputs
Q5  | W3.a | FR | x=7                    | Correct: 7               | PASS
Q6  | W3.e | FR | valid=1, extran=6      | Correct: valid=6, extran=1 | FAIL  labels swapped; found both roots but never checked back in original equation
Q7  | W3.d | MC | x=7                    | Correct: C=x=3/2         | FAIL  did not rewrite to same base
Q8  | W2.e | FR | h=-4, v=-2, refl, str=3 | Correct: same           | PASS  4/4 inputs
Q9  | W3.c | FR | v=10                   | Correct: 10              | PASS
Q10 | W4.a | FR | down, (1,12), -1 and 3 | Correct: same            | PASS  5/5 inputs
Q11 | W4.h | FR | a=-1/2, h=-4, k=5      | Correct: a=-2, h=-4, k=5 | PARTIAL  2/3 inputs; h and k correct, a wrong
Q12 | W5.a | MC | (3x+2)(x-4)            | Correct: D               | PASS
Q13 | W5.b | MC | (2x-5)(2x+5)           | Correct: A               | PASS
Q14 | W6.b | MC | (x+4)^2-9             | Correct: C=x=-1 or x=-7  | FAIL  completed the square correctly but stopped before taking sqrt and solving for x
Q15 | W6.c | MC | x=2 or x=1/2           | Correct: B=(5+/-sqrt(17))/4 | FAIL  4ac computed as 16 instead of 8; discriminant 9 instead of 17

KEY PATTERNS:
- W3.e: knows the algebra, never verified. Must check both roots in original equation.
- W3.d: jumped to a guess (x=7) instead of same-base rewrite. 4=2^2, 32=2^5 -> x=3/2.
- W4.h: a-value wrong on vertex form parabola. The multiply-back step when factoring out leading coefficient is the gap. Confirmed recurring.
- W6.b: process correct but incomplete. Stopped at (x+4)^2=9, did not finish to x=-1 or x=-7.
- W6.c: quadratic formula setup correct, arithmetic error on 4ac (computed 16 instead of 8).

This report is for posting to kai-scores-latest.json or equivalent score record. FR has also built finals-target-drill.json (12 questions, committed at 4f485d4) targeting W4.h, W2.c, W4.a, W2.b, W3.d, W5.a, W6.c for Kai's last prep session before Tuesday.
